race.comment: ART VOLANT (7) consistent mare who indicated she was back to her best first up with a slashing second over 1250m at Newcastle from an outside gate. Key jockey change and best form puts her right in this. VERBIL (1) placed in stronger company and fitter now third up. No match for Komodo Dragon last start when fourth over 1250m at Randwick Kensington. Worth thought over this trip. ELSON BOY (3) best form is over this distance and can improve sharply after he found the 1100m too short when twelfth at Dubbo. Can sit on the speed with the claim and run a cheeky race. SUPER HELPFUL (2) just a plain effort first up when sixth over 1300m at Bathurst. Has a decent second-up record and is in the mix.
